retainedDefinition.name: Contract size vs company size
retainedDefinition.explain: 8-K item 1.01 whose stated dollar value is over 10% of market cap (value from the filing / Exhibit 10, SEC official APIs); hold 20 days. Stop if most filings state no amount. Second pre-registered version (from the 20 Oct evening review): the contract value must also cover 4+ quarters of operating cash burn (10-Q cash flow).
retainedDefinition.status: pre-registered 22 Oct 2026 (both versions); queued as the next Agent C build
retainedDefinition.note: From the outside review of 20 Oct (see project doc Agent inbox). | PRE-REGISTERED 22 Oct 2026 (Agent C), exact rule: event = 8-K with item 1.01 (from the SEC event cache, acceptance time UTC -> New York session via sec-time.mjs; earnings-day 8-Ks excluded as in events-study). Amount = the LARGEST dollar figure written as '$X million' or '$X billion' (or '$X,XXX,XXX' of 1,000,000+) in the item 1.01 section of the primary 8-K document (EDGAR Archives, accession from the cache); figures inside 'up to' are counted, figures labelled credit facility / loan / notes / debt / lease are NOT (those are financing, not customer contracts). CT1a: amount >= 10% of market cap (close of the reaction session x SEC share count known by then). CT1b: CT1a AND amount >= 4 quarters of operating cash burn (minus NetCashProvidedByUsedInOperatingActivities, last 10-Q/10-K known 30 days before; companies with positive operating cash flow pass). Buy the open after the reaction session, hold 20 sessions; one event per stock per 60 sessions. STOP RULE: if under 40% of item 1.01 filings state any parsable amount, 'needs data'. Gates: 0.8% / 1.2% stress, both halves, vs average stock, S&P 500 and own other days, without 2 best; PROVEN at t >= max(own, league, 4.0); TRADABLE SMALL tier 2 = both halves positive after 1.2%, beats average stock and S&P, without 2 best positive, t >= 2.5. Universe caveat: the event cache covers the scan universe + watch list only.
